query: I’m evaluating a 48‑year‑old woman. For female inpatients aged 43–53 with heart failure and an ICU stay, report median (IQR) risk score, 30‑day mortality, major complication rate, and average LOS among survivors. Also provide this cohort’s risk percentile versus all females 43–53.
final_sql: SELECT rs.subject_id, rs.risk_score, m.mortality_count, c.complication_count, l.average_length_of_stay, percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY rs.risk_score) AS percentile_rank FROM risk_score rs JOIN mortality m ON rs.subject_id = m.subject_id JOIN complications c ON rs.subject_id = c.subject_id JOIN los l ON rs.subject_id = l.subject_id ORDER BY rs.subject_id NULLS LAST;
